factions.name: China
factions.title: Haitan Network
factions.story: A scattered force can hold ground. A connected force can choose where the battle happens. China’s fictional Haitan Network brings reconnaissance, precision armor and maritime reach into one coordinated offensive.
factions.playstyle: Keep specialists and escorts close to your main force. Use reconnaissance to commit your armor where it matters.
factions.strengths: Coordinated armor, specialist support and sea-to-land pressure.
factions.counterplay: Disrupt the supporting units and attack separated formations.

factions.name: Iran
factions.title: Distributed Denial
factions.tagline: Make every approach a difficult choice.
factions.story: In this fictional theatre, a dispersed defense turns coastlines and narrow approaches into contested ground. Iran’s force combines reconnaissance, mobile armor and overlapping air defense to make the opponent fight on unfavorable terms.
factions.playstyle: Build overlapping coverage and keep scouting. Move your armor under protection instead of committing it alone.
factions.strengths: Layered denial and mobile combined arms.
factions.counterplay: Scout coverage gaps, split the defense and pressure isolated specialists.

factions.name: Türkiye
factions.title: Anatolian Guard
factions.story: The Anatolian Guard is a fictional combined-arms force built to cross difficult ground without losing cohesion. Mechanized armor, drones and electronic warfare support a flexible approach to contested straits and inland routes.
factions.playstyle: Pair your armored spearhead with reconnaissance and air cover. Change the direction of pressure before the opponent settles.
factions.counterplay: Force unsupported units into fights and contest drone routes with air defense.

factions.name: Saudi Arabia
factions.title: Red Sea Command
factions.tagline: Hold the corridor. Protect the lifeline.
factions.story: In the fictional Red Sea 2026 campaign, Saudi forces must keep vital routes open under pressure. Heavy armor and professional infantry anchor a force that can hold ground while air power supports the next advance.
factions.playstyle: Use armor to anchor the push and infantry to secure the ground it takes.
factions.strengths: Durable armored formations supported by infantry and air power.
factions.counterplay: Avoid frontal armor trades; scout and pressure exposed support routes.

factions.name: Yemen
factions.title: Red Sea Resistance
factions.tagline: Choose the moment, not the front line.
factions.story: Across the fictional Red Sea 2026 theatre, a lighter force contests supply routes through mobility and selective pressure. Technicals and strike drones reward choosing engagements carefully instead of matching heavy armor head-on.
factions.playstyle: Scout first, attack exposed targets and relocate. Preserve mobile units for the next opportunity.
factions.strengths: Mobile harassment and asymmetric strike pressure.
factions.counterplay: Cover vulnerable routes and intercept light vehicles before they can disengage.

factions.name: Israel
factions.title: Precision support
factions.tagline: Protect the formation. Coordinate the strike.
factions.story: A fictional strategy-game roster built around protected armor, forward observation and vulnerable support nodes. Its statistics and abilities are game abstractions.
factions.playstyle: Keep armor, carriers and observers together. Use powered relays to improve firing cycles and service stations to preserve damaged vehicles.
factions.strengths: Durable armor, infantry transport, finite-ammunition aviation, guided fires and local support.
factions.counterplay: Attack support nodes, cut power and surround expensive units with anti-armor or air threats.

factions.name: Hezbollah
factions.title: Concealed defense
factions.tagline: Hold the ground. Move before the counterattack.
factions.story: A fictional strategy-game roster built around light forces, concealed positions and vulnerable support nodes. It depicts gameplay roles, not real-world capability or operational doctrine.
factions.playstyle: Scout, spread out and control approaches with concealed positions. Guide missiles through spotters and signal posts, then relocate before close attackers or artillery arrive.
factions.strengths: Low-cost forces, stationary concealment, guided rocket pressure and agile coastal craft.
factions.counterplay: Detect concealed units, destroy signal posts and close the artillery minimum-range gap. Light armor loses concentrated fights.

units.name: Signal Post
units.story: A powered, unarmed support building. Local benefits end when it is destroyed or loses power.
units.strengths: Supports eligible friendly units inside its visible range. Multiple sources do not multiply the bonus.
units.counterplay: Cut power, destroy the exposed node or fight outside its range.
